headlines.title: 정부, 중동전쟁 물가 대응 총력 … 농축수산물 할인·비축물량 방출

headlines.title: 공급 확대에 채소값 안정세 … 대형마트서 매출 늘어
headlines.summary: 오이·배추·무 가격 두자릿수 하락 축·수산물 부담에 소비 증가 뚜렷 식탁에 채소 반찬이 늘고 있다. 축·수산물 가격 부담이 커진 반면, 채소류 가격이 상대적으로 안정세를 보이면서다. 14일 한국농수산식품유통공사(aT) 농산물유통정보(KAMIS)에 따르면 지난 12일 기준 오이 10개는 8742원으로 전년 동기(1만1569원) 대비 24.44% 하락했다.

headlines.title: 외국인이 ‘ 다주택자 급매 잡았나 ’… 서울 944채 매수

headlines.summary: 한국 증시가 연일 ‘새 역사’를 써내려가고 있다. 꼭 1년 전 2640.57에 그쳤던 코스피 지수는 어느새 ‘1만피’를 넘볼 정도로 급등했다. ‘코스피 5000 시대’를 허황된 구호라고 비웃던 목소리가 무색해진 요즘이다. 증시로 돈이 몰리고, 외국인 자금 유입도 이어지며 증시 호황에 따른 경제 성장 기대감도 한껏 커지고 있다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

한국 경제는 1분기 성장세 확대로 일부 회복 흐름을 보이고 있으나, 정부 그린북은 5개월 연속 '경기 하방압력 증가'를 경고하며 이번 달에는 처음으로 **관세로 인한 수출 둔화** 리스크를 명시적으로 추가했다. 미국의 4월 수입물가가 에너지 급등을 중심으로 4년 만에 최고치(1.9%)를 기록하면서 글로벌 인플레이션 압력이 재부상하고 있으며, 이는 수출 중심 한국 경제에 추가적인 부담 요인으로 작용할 수 있다. OECD 역시 한국 등 수출 주도형 경제의 성과가 가계의 실질적 압박을 상쇄하지 못하고 있다고 지적해, **성장과 민간 체감경기 간의 괴리** 문제가 구조적 과제로 부각되고 있다. 채권 시장에서는 대형 기관과 소형 투자 주체 간의 수급 주도권 경쟁이 심화되는 양상이며, 중동발 지정학적 불안과 미국발 관세 충격이 맞물려 당분간 경기 불확실성이 높은 국면이 지속될 전망이다.

top5_headlines.summary: 정부, 중동전쟁 물가대응팀 회의 개최 농축수산물, 5~6월 220억원 규모 할인 지원 돼지고기·고등어·오징어·갈치 공급물량 확대 [서울=뉴시스] 최진석 기자 = 서울 한 마트 돼지고기 코너의 모습. 2026.04.08. myjs@newsis.

top5_headlines.title: 정부, 중동전쟁 물가 대응 총력 … 농축수산물 할인·비축물량 방출
top5_headlines.summary: 핵심요약 재경부 이형일 1차관 주재 물가관계차관회의 매점매석 제재 강화·축산물 공급 확대 등 추진 연합뉴스 정부가 중동전쟁 장기화에 따른 물가 불안에 대응해 농축수산물 할인 지원과 정부 비축물량 방출, 축산물 수입 확대 등을 추진한다.

key_headlines.title: Green Book May Report Shows Downward Economic Pressures Persist Amid Tariff Concerns
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's economic outlook remains clouded as the May Green Book warns of continued downward pressure on the economy, with tariffs now cited as an additional factor dampening exports for the fifth consecutive month.

key_headlines.title: New Monetary Policy Committee Member Kim Jin-il Takes Office Amid Middle East Inflation Concerns
key_headlines.summary: Former Federal Reserve official Kim Jin-il was appointed to the Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee and pledged to leverage his macroeconomic expertise to achieve price stability amid Middle Eastern inflation risks.

key_headlines.title: Samsung Strike Fears Trigger Black Friday in Korean Stock Market
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI experienced significant volatility as Samsung Electronics union's strong stance combined with global bond market turmoil and foreign investor risk-off sentiment, dragging the index lower despite earlier gains.

key_headlines.title: Government Accelerates Major Public Housing Project Timelines by Up to One Year
key_headlines.summary: Vice Premier Koo Yoon-cheol announced that housing supply at major public sites including Gwacheon and Taereung will be accelerated, with construction beginning in 2029 instead of 2030 to address supply shortages.

key_headlines.title: Gaon Electric Posts Record Q1 Results Driven by US AI Data Center Demand
key_headlines.summary: Gaon Electric achieved record first-quarter revenue of 763.6 billion won and operating profit of 27.8 billion won, driven by surging demand for power distribution products from expanding US AI data centers.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic momentum faces renewed headwinds as the May Green Book extends warnings of downward economic pressure to a fifth consecutive month, now citing tariffs as a dampening factor on export growth. While some economic indicators suggest recovery prospects in the first quarter, the outlook remains clouded by Middle Eastern inflation risks and global financial market volatility. The government and central bank are closely monitoring price pressures from energy shocks and external financial conditions, with policy responses becoming increasingly complex as they balance growth and stability objectives.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The appointment of new Monetary Policy Committee member Kim Jin-il, a former Federal Reserve official, signals the Bank of Korea's focus on price stability and financial risk management during uncertain times. Rating agency Fitch maintained its base case for policy rate hold throughout 2026 but acknowledged upside risks to inflation from energy shocks that could trigger rate hikes in the latter half of the year. Import price deflation was notably recorded in April, marking the largest monthly decline since the 1998 Asian financial crisis, though price pressures remain a key policy concern amid global bond market turmoil.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI experienced significant volatility and volatility-triggered circuit breakers as Samsung Electronics labor union tensions combined with global bond market weakness, with US 30-year Treasury yields breaking through 5 percent and Japanese 10-year rates reaching post-1997 highs. Foreign investors scaled back risk exposure amid macroeconomic uncertainties, with the market showing technical support around 7,000 levels after profit-taking from earlier gains approaching 8,000. Multiple new active ETF products are launching to provide investors with enhanced index-tracking and mixed asset strategies.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korea's advanced manufacturing sectors demonstrate robust growth momentum, with HLB Innovation recording 24 percent revenue growth in the first quarter driven by semiconductor demand from AI and electric vehicle trends. Korean construction automation technology has attracted 25.6 billion won in investment and is gaining traction in US markets for solar, battery storage, and AI data center projects, with projected full-year revenues exceeding 63 billion won. Korean manufacturing advantages in robots, semiconductors, space technology, and small modular reactors (SMR) are increasingly positioning the nation as a leader in next-generation industries.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment rental market dynamics shifted as multi-unit property owners began converting held inventory into jeonse and monthly rentals rather than sales, following implementation of increased capital gains taxes, leading to a 30 percent surge in rental listings in Seocho district. The government accelerated public housing supply timelines by up to one year, with major projects at Gwacheon and Taereung now scheduled for construction start in 2029, alongside plans to expand non-apartment housing options including officetels and urban residential units. Housing price pressures are expected to persist in the near term due to ongoing supply constraints despite government efforts to increase residential availability.
sections.International Economy: New Federal Reserve Chairman Wash assumes his leadership role amid significant policy pressures from the Trump administration's push for rate cuts, global inflation concerns, and divided sentiment among FOMC voting members following policy divergence in April. The Fed faces a delicate balancing act as 30-year US Treasury yields exceed 5 percent and international bond markets signal expectations for extended monetary tightness, complicating the incoming chairman's first policy meeting scheduled for mid-June. Strategic dialogue between the United States and China continues on trade and geopolitical issues, with both nations maintaining diplomatic channels despite ongoing commercial tensions.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korean companies are capitalizing on surging US AI data center expansion, with Gaon Electric achieving record quarterly results through increased busduct exports for power distribution in mega data centers. Korean construction automation firms are successfully penetrating US markets for AI infrastructure projects, while semiconductor and interconnect technology developers are positioning themselves in the competitive AI efficiency market. Nobel laureate economist Peter Howitt advised Korea to diversify research and development investments across multiple sectors rather than concentrating on select fields, emphasizing that total factor productivity improvements require broader technological innovation initiatives.
sections.Others: Single-stock leveraged ETFs tracking individual stock returns at 2x multipliers are launching on May 27th, offering sophisticated short-term traders enhanced exposure but carrying substantial intraday loss risks up to 60 percent. WTO member nations introduced trade and technical barriers at a 20 percent rate over the past year, with chemical regulations restricting certain flame retardants expected to disrupt automotive supply chains beginning January 2027. Nobel Prize-winning economist Peter Howitt suggested that excess profits from AI companies should not yet be redistributed to society, emphasizing the importance of maintaining growth incentives during the AI transformation period.
